title: Fell apart
text:
Fell apart. On one edge of the blanket I received, the sewing was bunched up. I ordered rainbow, and it was mostly pink and mine did not come with lots of little swirls of rainbow color, but large blobs of color and in one area where all the colors mixed together, it was a brownish. It wasn't a large spot, and for the price, I was going to be ok with it.

But the bunched up area came undone, thread everywhere, way more than should have been in there. I think it had to have got caught at the factory, and no one noticed it. Well, it came apart after the return window closed, so now I have two halves of a blanket. If I ever get a sewing machine, I'll be able to fix it, but I can't give it a good rating like this. I will still give it two stars though, because it was super soft, warm and cute, for a good price.
